This was a founding client build. Projects begin at $3,000, and a site this size is quoted after the conversation.

Home

Before · her current site

Portrait-first and generic. The old homepage led with "Palm Coast Wedding Photographers" but read like every other local site: stock-feeling layout, a template from the PhotoBiz builder, no clear premium signal.

After · the new site

A premium editorial homepage. Real reviews (Best of Weddings, 5.0 on Google and The Knot), her voice, clean navigation, and fast, sharp full-bleed imagery that positions her at the top of the market.

About

Before · her current site

"Portrait Photographer Based in Florida." Two photos, one line of text, and a headline that buried the wedding work under generic portraiture. Nothing about her story, her fifteen years, or why couples choose her.

After · the new site

Her real story, in her own words. Bogotá, her grandfather's camera, the years in medicine that asked too much of her heart, becoming a mother, and why she never stops shooting. Written to make the right couple feel she has already been waiting for them.

Weddings

Before · her current site

A gallery with no strategy. Photos with little narrative, no pricing guidance, and no path from "I like these" to "let's book."

After · the new site

A page built to convert. Clear pricing (collections from $3,200), real couples and stories, the second-photographer option, and calls to action that lead straight to "Check Your Date."

The Pricing, Repositioned

Her rates were about five years stale, pricing her like the local one-photographer crowd while she delivers documentary, editorial work. Every new number is backed by the July 2026 Northeast-Florida market report, and she still sits below the true-luxury ceiling, with room to grow.
